cleaner.title: Device Cleaner
cleaner.subtitle: Frees space and memory on this box. Nothing you are signed into gets signed out.
cleaner.notNative: The cleaner only works inside the installed Snow Media Center app on your TV box.

storage.title: Storage
storage.nearlyFull: This box is nearly full. That is what makes app updates fail with “App not installed” and streams stutter — clean it and try again.

memory.title: Memory
memory.low: The box is short on memory right now.

phase.working: Working through {{app}} — Settings opens and closes by itself. Leave the remote alone.
phase.settingsOpens: Settings will open by itself. Leave the remote alone until it comes back.

all.title: Clean this box
all.desc: Leftover files, background apps, then every app cache
all.descReach: Leftover files, background apps, then every app cache — about {{size}} in reach

usage.onDesc: Sizes and last-used dates are visible

fire.title: Fire TV clears caches one app at a time
fire.body: Fire TV has no setting that lets another app empty caches for you, so the Cleaner takes you to Fire TV’s own page for each app instead. Pick an app below, choose <1>Clear cache</1> on the page that opens, then press Back to land straight back here. Leftover files and background apps are still cleared in one press.
fire.cacheHidden: Cache size is hidden on Fire TV

gate.title: One switch to turn on
gate.body: Android will not let any app empty another app’s cache on its own. In the list that opens, find <1>Snow Media Cache Cleaner</1> and switch it on — then come back here and press Clean. It only ever taps “Clear cache”, never “Clear data”, and you can switch it off again whenever you like. Everything else on this screen works without it.

unused.title: Apps nobody opens
unused.needUsage: Turn on app usage above and this box will list what has not been opened in {{days}} days, with what each one takes up.
unused.none: Everything installed here gets used. Nothing to remove.
unused.more: {{count}} more, smallest first — clean the big ones and check again.

check.title: Worth a look
check.desc: Apps that did not come from a store, and apps with no way to open them. Most are harmless — a sideload you asked for, or a helper another app installed. The ads and pop-ups people blame on their box are usually one of these.

lines.fireCaches: app caches: pick an app in the Fire TV list below to clear its cache
lines.askedToStop_one: {{count}} app asked to stop background work
lines.askedToStop_other: {{count}} apps asked to stop background work

toast.fireCachesTitle: Caches are one app at a time on Fire TV
toast.fireCachesDesc: Pick an app in the list further down and choose Clear cache on the page that opens.
toast.turnOnDesc: Switch on Snow Media Cache Cleaner under Accessibility. The button at the bottom of this screen opens that list.
toast.openListTitle: Could not open the app list
toast.openListDesc: On the Fire TV home screen go to Settings → Applications → Manage Installed Applications, pick an app, then Clear cache.
toast.byHandDesc: Android Settings → Accessibility → Snow Media Cache Cleaner.
toast.noUsageTitle: This box has no usage screen
toast.noUsageDesc: Cache clearing and background closing still work. Sizes and last-used dates will stay hidden.

playbackFreed.title: Smoother playback
playbackFreed.body: Closed apps running in the background and freed {{mb}} MB of memory.
